name: Software Fingerprint Analysis
description: Deep analysis of software signatures, version patterns, and encoding fingerprints to identify specific AI generation tools, camera manufacturers, and image processing pipelines.
mechanism: Matches metadata values against comprehensive databases of AI tools (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, ComfyUI, etc.), camera manufacturers (Canon, Nikon, Sony, etc.), and encoding libraries (libjpeg, Pillow, OpenCV) to identify the image's processing chain.
parameters:
AI tools: 25+ signatures including Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, ComfyUI, InvokeAI, Leonardo.AI, etc.
Camera brands: Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Apple, Samsung, etc.
Encoding libraries: libjpeg, MozJPEG, Pillow, OpenCV
accuracy: Very High - 90-95% when software signatures are present in metadata.
source: Stable Diffusion GitHub, OpenAI API Documentation, Midjourney Documentation
